compiled_state.description:
## Problem
The codebase is jammed against the module-size gate. Measured on origin/main 2026-08-19, these
`src/rebar` files sit within 20 lines of the 800-LOC HARD cap, two of them AT it:

| LOC | file | covered elsewhere? |
|---|---|---|
| 800 | `_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py` | no |
| 800 | `signing.py` | YES — `stealthy-appetizing-coelacanth`, excluded from this epic |
| 799 | `_engine/rebar_reconciler/apply_inbound_records.py` | no |
| 799 | `config.py` | claimed by in-flight work, excluded |
| 799 | `_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile.py` | YES — RP-03 S5, excluded |
| 798 | `_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py` | handled inline by Gerrit 1916, excluded |
| 795 | `_config_sources.py` | claimed by in-flight work, excluded |
| 793 | `llm/plan_review/det_floor.py` | no |
| 793 | `llm/plan_review/__init__.py` | YES — `sullen-famished-incatern`, excluded |
| 790 | `llm/workflow/executor.py` | no |
| 790 | `llm/plan_review/sidecar.py` | YES — two open tickets, excluded |
| 789 | `llm/prompting/prompts.py` | no |
| 786 | `_commands/init.py` | no |
| 782 | `_engine/rebar_reconciler/applier.py` | YES — RP-03 + others, excluded |

The CI module-size gate is a HARD FAIL with no allowlist, and the limit in
`.github/module-size-limit.txt` is LOCKED — a normal contributor change to it fails CI. So any
edit to a file at 799 or 800, INCLUDING ADDING A COMMENT, fails the build.

This is not hypothetical. Gerrit change 1916 was failed by exactly this: it added a six-line
justification comment to `__main__.py` (798) and landed at 804. That is a queue of latent CI
failures sitting in front of anyone who touches these files next.

## Scope
This epic covers ONLY the six files with no other owner: `inbound_differ.py`,
`apply_inbound_records.py`, `det_floor.py`, `llm/workflow/executor.py`, `llm/prompting/prompts.py`,
`_commands/init.py`. Coverage was verified against the file_impact of all 101 open/in_progress
tickets and against the prose of every open RP epic. Files owned by RP epics or by other open
tickets are deliberately EXCLUDED so this epic never competes for the same file.

## Non-negotiable constraints on every child
- **Split along LOGICAL CONCERNS and ARCHITECTURAL BOUNDARIES.** Extract a cluster of functions that
  already call each other, following a seam the call graph already has. Do NOT carve mechanically to
  get under a number. The commit message must NAME the concern boundary chosen.
- **Never raise the limit.** `.github/module-size-limit.txt` is locked and is not the fix.
- **No file under 100 LOC** may be created by a split; target 200-500 LOC per resulting file.
- **Leave real headroom.** Landing at 798 recreates this exact problem for the next person — which
  is how 1916 failed. A split that buys 2 lines has not done the job.
- **Behaviour-preserving.** Existing tests for the affected area must pass UNMODIFIED. If a test must
  change, that is evidence the split was not behaviour-preserving — stop and reconsider the seam.
- **Both navigation tools.** Serena `find_referencing_symbols` for the reference set, THEN a plain
  `grep` for every moved symbol's name AS A STRING (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib).
  Serena returns EMPTY — not an error — for receivers typed `Any`, so the grep is mandatory.

## Provenance
Filed 2026-08-19 under explicit operator authorization to split files at or near the LOC cap that
are not covered by existing RP epics, with the instruction that splits follow logical concerns and
architectural boundaries.
compiled_state.title: Restore headroom under the 800-LOC module-size cap (6 uncovered files at 786-800)
